Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.py with the function at module scope.
Required API: def quota_ledger(input: str) -> str | None
Behavior: Parse limit;account:delta records. Limit is a canonical unsigned decimal in 0..10000000; accounts use ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*; deltas are canonical signed decimals in -10000000..10000000. Apply in order from zero and reject any balance below zero or above limit. Return all touched account balances sorted by account.
Visible example: 10;a:4,b:3,a:-1 returns a=3,b=3.

import re
def quota_ledger(s):
 p=s.split(';')
 if len(p)!=2 or not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',p[0]) or int(p[0])>10000000 or not p[1]:return None
 limit=int(p[0]);d={}
 for r in p[1].split(','):
  q=r.split(':')
  if len(q)!=2 or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*',q[0]) or not re.fullmatch(r'0|-?[1-9][0-9]*',q[1]):return None
  x=int(q[1])
  if abs(x)>10000000:return None
  v=d.get(q[0],0)+x
  if v<0 or v>limit:return None
  d[q[0]]=v
 return ','.join(f'{k}={d[k]}' for k in sorted(d))
